### Community 1689 - "New findings (not in Wave 1)"
Cohesion: 0.12

### Community 1690 - "New findings (not in Wave 1)"
Cohesion: 0.12

### Community 2021 - "Findings (Wave 2)"
Cohesion: 0.14
Nodes (13): F-04-W2-001 — MCP SSE HTTP transport is a process-global singleton (cross-client interference + transport thrash), F-04-W2-002 — MCP internal `omniRouteFetch` / `apiFetch` forward management credentials to env-controlled base URL (no host pin), F-04-W2-003 — `plugin_install` accepts any absolute filesystem path → load/activate runs untrusted code in a child process, F-04-W2-004 — MCP tool error paths return raw `err.message` (and full upstream HTTP bodies) — Hard Rule #12, F-04-W2-005 — `omniroute_set_budget_guard` is in-memory theater; never enforced on the request path, F-04-W2-006 — Dynamic `skill_*` MCP tools never load the DB skill registry at registration time, F-04-W2-007 — Streamable MCP sessions: fire-and-forget `connect`, no principal binding, no session cap, F-04-W2-008 — Live dashboard WebSocket accepts any valid inference API key (no `manage` scope) (+5 more)

### Community 2022 - "Findings (severity-ordered)"
Cohesion: 0.14
Nodes (14): F-05-001 — JWT / API signing secrets stored plaintext in SQLite, F-05-002 — Inference API keys persisted in plaintext alongside hash, F-05-003 — Web-session / cookie credentials stored unencrypted in `provider_specific_data`, F-05-004 — `validateRegisteredKey` budget check uses stale counters after window reset, F-05-005 — Usage history rollup is additive and not crash-safe (double-count), F-05-006 — OAuth re-auth update path does not lockstep `tokenExpiresAt` with `expiresAt`, F-05-007 — Field encryption fails open to plaintext on encrypt errors, F-05-008 — Proxy registry passwords stored plaintext (only relay notes partially encrypted) (+6 more)
